q1_online_learning.design: online and frozen copies start from identical complete interaction state on every stream
q1_online_learning.positive_means: weight updating helped under the same stream time structure
q1_online_learning.question: Does online weight updating improve prediction against a matched frozen copy?
q1_online_learning.statistic: frozen minus online mean normalized error

q2_adaptation.design: difference-of-differences, fully crossed over initializations and environments
q2_adaptation.positive_means: part of the online advantage is caused by the change
q2_adaptation.question: Does continued learning help because the world changed?

q3_hidden_state.question: Does persistent recurrent state provide measurable value?
q3_hidden_state.statistic: control minus AAA-1K mean normalized error

q4_gating.capacity_note: 954 parameters against 994, but 28 hidden units against 16. Matching on parameters necessarily buys the ungated arm more state, because that is what a gate costs. This is the honest comparison at a fixed parameter budget and is not a comparison at matched hidden width.
q4_gating.question: Does gated recurrence provide value beyond plain recurrence?
q4_gating.statistic: ungated RNN minus AAA-1K mean normalized error

tuning_fairness.finding: the comparison is inconclusive once each architecture is tuned separately, so Q4's negative result is weaker than the shared-rate comparison suggested
tuning_fairness.question: does Q4's negative result survive giving each architecture its own learning rate?

q5_retention.design: fixed held-out probe bank; fully crossed over initializations and training environments
q5_retention.positive_means: the model forgot regime A while learning B
q5_retention.question: Does the model preserve prior capability after learning a new regime?
q5_retention.statistic: probe error after B minus probe error after A1

q6_error_calibration.caveat: a learned error-magnitude estimate, not a calibrated predictive distribution and not a Bayesian posterior
q6_error_calibration.question: Can the model estimate its own likely error?
q6_error_calibration.units: normalized displacement, the units the error head is trained in

q7_baseline_competitiveness.decision_rule: a win requires the whole 95% interval above zero, declared in advance
q7_baseline_competitiveness.inference_scope: exploratory descriptive comparisons; no family-baseline cell is promoted as a multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim
q7_baseline_competitiveness.question: Does the extra complexity beat simpler AAA baselines anywhere?
q7_baseline_competitiveness.statistic: baseline minus AAA-1K mean normalized error

capability_vector.note: dimensions are reported separately and are not combined into a single score

design.note: fresh round-3 identities; complete crossed designs
